product_overview: Home Putra Interior AI is a smart web-based dashboard designed to assist sales teams and customers in accurate price estimation, design consultation, and interior material selection, leveraging Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology to offer real-time, data-backed AI consultation and instant budgeting.
core_goals: Provide real-time pricing information with centralized and easily updated databases.
Eliminate AI hallucination by integrating RAG technology that enforces data-backed AI responses.
Accelerate project budget estimation through instant AI calculations.
Simplify material comparison for clients through user-friendly head-to-head feature.
key_features: Interactive AI Chat Assistant using RAG to deliver accurate interior design and pricing consultations.
Real-time Digital Pricing Catalog showcasing Kitchen Sets, Wallpanels, and Wardrobes with search and filter capabilities.
Proposal Generator to convert consultation chats into neatly formatted quotations with one-click copy functionality.
Material Battle module for comparing different interior materials on various technical aspects.
Rules & Guidelines Panel displaying policies, shipping info, and FAQs for user reference.
user_flow_summary: Admin updates pricing data in `pricing-data.ts` and runs embedding generation via `setup-rag.ts` to sync with TiDB vector database.
Users ask natural language questions regarding budget and design needs through the web interface.
System converts queries to vector form, retrieves relevant product data from TiDB, and forwards context plus query to LLM (Groq API).
AI provides accurate, data-driven answers with detailed pricing and material suggestions.
Users can generate and copy proposals directly from chat for client communication.
validation_criteria: Chat assistant answers must consistently reference real-time data from the TiDB vector database, eliminating hallucinations.
Pricing catalog displays accurate and up-to-date product prices and specifications.
Proposal generation produces correctly formatted quotations matching chat context.
Material comparison module accurately reflects key technical differences between materials.
Admin scripts for data ingestion and embeddings run successfully and update the vector database without errors.
User interactions with chatbot and UI elements respond within acceptable performance thresholds.
